# appdynamics_action_suppression (Data Source)

Retrieves the details of a specific AppDynamics action suppression, looked up by either action_suppression_id or name (exactly one must be set).

## Example Usage

```terraform
# Look up by ID:
data "appdynamics_action_suppression" "by_id" {
  application_id        = 42
  action_suppression_id = 150
}

# ...or by name (exactly one of action_suppression_id / name must be set):
data "appdynamics_action_suppression" "by_name" {
  application_id = 42
  name           = "Weekend Maintenance"
}

output "maintenance_window_affects" {
  value = data.appdynamics_action_suppression.by_name.affects_json
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `application_id` (Number) ID of the business application this action suppression belongs to.

### Optional

- `action_suppression_id` (Number) ID of the action suppression to retrieve. Exactly one of action_suppression_id or name must be set.
- `name` (String) Name of the action suppression to retrieve. Exactly one of action_suppression_id or name must be set.

### Read-Only

- `affects_json` (String)
- `disable_agent_reporting` (Boolean)
- `end_time` (String)
- `health_rule_scope_json` (String)
- `recurring_schedule_json` (String)
- `start_time` (String)
- `suppression_schedule_type` (String)
- `timezone` (String)
